name: Lumen
description: A radiant weapon that is strong almost immediately and then grows slowly: the light it holds arrives all at once, and everything after that is refinement. Features Flash [Z] and Radiance [X].

phases.name: Phase 1: Glimmer
phases.effects: A pale sliver of light held inside a plain edge. Faint, steady, and brighter than it has any right to be. Base 120 DMG and 400 HP.
phases.notification: Light. Small, but it is not going out.

phases.name: Phase 2: Glow
phases.effects: The blade warms and starts to carry its own light, leaving short bright streaks behind every swing. Base 480 DMG and 1,600 HP.
phases.notification: It is not reflecting anything. It is making its own.

phases.name: Phase 3: Gleam
phases.effects: Hard light runs along the edge in a continuous line, and sparks of it fall away as you move. Base 1,900 DMG and 6,500 HP.
phases.notification: Bright enough to hurt to look at.

phases.name: Phase 4: Beam
phases.effects: The blade stops looking like a blade and starts looking like a held beam, with a bright halo and light spilling off both edges. Base 7,200 DMG and 25,000 HP.
phases.notification: It is not a shape any more. It is a direction.

phases.name: Phase 5: Radiance
phases.effects: Light pours off the blade as a field rather than a line: a glowing ring around the wielder and rays thrown clear with every strike. Base 26,000 DMG and 95,000 HP.
phases.notification: The light has stopped staying in the blade.

phases.name: Phase 6: Solaris
phases.effects: A small sun bound into steel: layered light, heat distortion and flares that linger after the swing has ended. Base 88,000 DMG and 300,000 HP.
phases.notification: Everything you have swung at is still lit up.

phases.name: Phase 7: Eclipse
phases.effects: DELIBERATE COLLAPSE. The light is blocked, not lost: a dull grey blade with only a thin rim of glow surviving. Unlocks Flash [Z] — a burst of light that deals 220% damage and stuns everything within your swing range for 1.4s. Base 9 DMG and 60 HP.
phases.notification: ...Where did it go? Something is standing in front of it.

phases.name: Phase 8: Daybreak
phases.effects: The block lifts and the light comes back all at once, brighter than before the eclipse: long rays, a strong halo and light pooling on the ground. Base 200,000 DMG and 680,000 HP.
phases.notification: It came back. It came back angry.

phases.name: Phase 9: Zenith
phases.effects: The light reaches its highest point and holds there: steady, unwavering, throwing long shadows in every direction. Base 370,000 DMG and 1,250,000 HP.
phases.notification: Noon. Exactly noon. It will not move.

phases.name: Phase 10: Corona
phases.effects: A layered ring of light forms permanently around the blade, constant flares peeling off it and heat bending the air behind you. Base 620,000 DMG and 2,100,000 HP.
phases.notification: The light has structure now. Layers. It is wearing a crown.

phases.name: Phase 11: Halo
phases.effects: The radiance settles into orbit: rotating halos around the wielder, light that folds back on itself and a glare that never quite fades. Base 960,000 DMG and 3,200,000 HP.
phases.notification: It is not shining at you any more. It is shining around you.

phases.name: Phase 12: Occultation
phases.effects: DELIBERATE COLLAPSE. The light is hidden again — a stone-grey blade with a single surviving seam of glow, but the blade underneath is no longer harmless. Unlocks Radiance [X] — a 4s aura that heals 10% of max HP per second while burning every enemy inside it for 45% damage each second. Base 210,000 DMG and 470,000 HP.
phases.notification: Hidden. Not gone. Hidden things still burn.

phases.name: Phase 13: Supernova
phases.effects: The blade is a contained detonation: blinding core, expanding shells of light and rays that keep travelling after the swing stops. Base 1,500,000 DMG and 4,600,000 HP.
phases.notification: It is not growing any more. It is about to let go.

phases.name: Phase 14: Eternal Noon
phases.effects: FINAL TRANSFORMATION: ETERNAL NOON. Lumen no longer emits light — it is the source, and the light simply never stops arriving. There is no shadow left anywhere near you. Base 2,000,000 DMG, 6,000,000 HP and 118 SPD. Shine.
phases.notification: The sun is not in the sky any more. It is in your hand, and it is not setting.
